look_here_first: Look at an OPPOSITE HEART-BASED LEAF with generally FLAT (not wavy) margins, then follow its axil to a clustered UMBEL of little creamy to rosy pink star flowers with a GLOSSY WHITE five-part corona in the center. The flowers are relatively SMALL, with petals about 3–6 mm, unlike large brown/orange F. crispum corollas (~20mm across).

key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Perennial twining milkweed vine with white latex and slender flexible stems (no tendrils).

key_traits.label: Stems
key_traits.text: Thin, often sprawling/twining green stems; fine short curved trichomes occur on stems and flower stalks.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite simple petiolate blades often ovate, lanceolate, or slightly arrow-shaped and typically cordate at base; widest variable ~0.7–4.5 cm; margins usually PLANE rather than crispate or strongly wavy.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Axillary umbel-like cymes, sometimes appearing as rounded bouquet of many little flowers; compare size of ONE open flower rather than head size alone.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Cream/white or rose-tinged five-lobed spreading corolla, petal lobes ~3–6mm, often pink at tips and fringed/ciliate at petal margins. Corolla inner face can be minutely hispidulous to nearly smooth (Flora of North America).

key_traits.label: Corona
key_traits.text: Five glossy white swollen ovoid corona lobes around the milkweed gynostegium, often with cream/green/pink base; central coronas are NOT unopened flower buds or petals.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Usually lone slender oblong to lanceolate follicle ~6–9cm long, curved-hairy, with 20–50 brown winged seeds bearing silky coma.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: cream-to-pink small five-petaled stars in umbel-like heads

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: five plump brilliant white oval corona lobes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mostly flat-edged cordate ovate-lanceolate opposite leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: thin twining stems with white latex

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: seeds in slender follicle with white silky coma
